facts.summary: Reviewed requirement context; retain all conditions and unassessed prerequisites.

value.label: Eligible partner or affiliate school applicant
value.rule: The nine-month, full-time MSMS is for students from partner or affiliate schools who are completing or hold an MBA or comparable management master’s degree. GMAT Focus/10th or GRE is required, with no published minimum. The reviewed Sloan page does not establish its English-test policy. For 2027 entry, the application deadline is February 18, 2027, at 3 p.m. ET. Materials include an application, transcript, résumé and employment history, essays or video statement, two recommendations, test evidence, and an interview by invitation.
